prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1218; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the claim you reported following the sideswipe collision. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just go by the claim, but I suppose that's fine. Go ahead and note it.

Q: Understood. Can you describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision occurred?

A: I was driving on the highway in Katy, Texas, in the right lane. I needed to move over because my exit was coming up, so I checked my mirror, signaled, and started to change lanes.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you moved over?

A: Not really. I looked, but it was in my blind spot. I thought the lane was clear. Next thing I knew there was a loud scrape and my car got pushed toward the shoulder.

Q: Did you have any contact with the other driver after the collision?

A: We pulled onto the shoulder. He said he didn't see me either. We exchanged insurance information and that was about it.

Q: Thank you. Now let's talk about your injuries. Where are you feeling pain?

A: My neck is stiff, and there's a dull ache across my lower back. It got worse the next morning. I've been taking over-the-counter pain relievers and using a heating pad.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same evening and I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week since then.

Q: Did you have any neck or back problems before this collision?

A: I had some occasional stiffness from sitting at a desk, but nothing that stopped me from working or doing my normal activities.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want my car repaired and my back to feel normal again.

Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
